mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.25% in a month signals tightening monetary policy, which increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances when the trigger condition is met, or if the correlation between FEDFUNDS increase and negative returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A significant increase in housing starts (HOUST) by more than 5% in two months indicates a strengthening demand in the housing market, which is a leading indicator for overall economic growth, thus driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of the instances when the trigger condition is met, or if the correlation between HOUST increase and positive returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% in a month signals a tightening labor market, which increases wage pressures and corporate costs, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances when the trigger condition is met, or if the correlation between UNRATE decrease and negative returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% in two months signals increased economic activity and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances, or if the correlation between INDPRO increase and positive returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) and a decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 1% and 0.3% respectively in two months indicates strong consumer demand and a tightening labor market, which boosts corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS increases > 1% and UNRATE decreases > 0.3% in 2 months
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of the instances when the trigger condition is met, or if the joint correlation between RSAFS increase, UNRATE decrease, and positive returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) increases by more than 0.5% in a month, it signals inflationary pressure, which typically leads to monetary tightening and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances when the trigger condition is met, or if the correlation between CPIAUCSL increase and negative returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 100,000 in a month signals a weakening labor market, which is a leading indicator of economic slowdown, thus driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances when the trigger condition is met, or if the correlation between PAYEMS decrease and negative returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When GDP (GDPC1) growth rate falls below 1% quarter-over-quarter, it signals a slowdown in economic activity, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the instances when the trigger condition is met, or if the correlation between GDPC1 growth slowdown and negative returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).
